A Legacy Of Passion & Flavour

Zam Zam Hotel

Our family's hospitality journey began with the iconic Zam Zam Hotel in Bandra, Mumbai.

Danish Bake House

The second generation expanded the family legacy with the launch of Danish Bake House, serving quality bakery products and savoury delights.

Danish Ice N' Spice

The second generation moved on to culinary expertise with Danish Ice N' Spice, a family restaurant in Mangalore.

Gyros Kitchen

Our journey as entrepreneurs began with the launch of Gyros Kitchen, a compact Quick Service Restaurant in Hennur specialising in freshly prepared rolls, wraps, shawarmas and quick bites. Despite its modest size, it quickly earned a loyal customer base and laid the foundation for our future ventures.

Gyros Kitchen 2.0

Building on our success, we launched our second outlet in Kammanahalli, transforming Gyros Kitchen into a casual dining destination. Today we are best known for our Mandi in Bangalore, alongside Arabic, Chinese and Indian cuisine.

Abu Shawaya

Inspired by the bold flavours of Arabia and infused with the signature Mangalorean spice profile, we launched Abu Shawaya, specialising in authentic Shawaya and Broasted Chicken that quickly won the hearts of food lovers.

Smash Club

Expanding into the premium burger segment, we launched Smash Club, a brand known for handcrafted smashed burgers, quality ingredients and bold flavours that set a new benchmark for burger lovers in Bangalore.

ZEVA Mandi & Grills

As a tribute to our roots, we introduced ZEVA Mandi & Grills in Mangalore — bringing together authentic Arabian cuisine, premium grills, elegant ambience, and the hospitality values our family has cherished for generations.

Zeva Mandi & Grills

Turkish & Arabic themed multi-cuisine mandi restaurant in Mangalore. Shop no G03 Jeppu, Arfa Mirage tower, Morgans Gate Rd, Bolar, Mangaluru 575001.
